name: Ranger Glynda Nal'Shea
summary: Near Auberdine, Ranger Glynda Nal'Shea keeps watch over Darkshore. She sends travelers against dangers on the coast and to investigate strange signs.

sections.title: Guardian of Auberdine
sections.body: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea directs scouts from Auberdine as corruption grows and hostile forces press into Darkshore. She watches the wilderness around town and calls on capable travelers to guard the perimeter. Their aid helps protect night elf holdings along the coast.

sections.title: Threats Along the Coast
sections.body: Glynda watches the shore for danger, especially the bolder murlocs south of town. She oversees bounties on threats such as Murkdeep and sends scouts to examine strange finds. One report speaks of a crimson crystal near Darkshore's eastern mountain range.

faq.answer: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea is a night elf stationed in Auberdine. She organizes scout patrols and defenses across Darkshore.

faq.q: Where can Glynda Nal'Shea be found?
faq.answer: Glynda Nal'Shea can be found in Auberdine, Darkshore's main Alliance settlement. She is near the sentinel watch and the town entrances.

faq.q: What quests does Ranger Glynda Nal'Shea offer?
faq.answer: Glynda offers work against dangers in the region, including a bounty on Murkdeep and an investigation of the red crystal along Darkshore's cliffs.

faq.q: Why is Glynda concerned about Murkdeep?
faq.answer: Murkdeep is a vicious murloc chieftain whose attacks threaten the southern coast and Auberdine's security. His targets include night elf outposts and travelers.

faq.q: What is the Red Crystal quest line?
faq.answer: Glynda begins the Red Crystal investigation by sending scouts up Darkshore's eastern cliffs. They examine a strange, pulsing crystal and retrieve fragments for study.

faq.q: What faction does Glynda Nal'Shea serve?
faq.answer: Glynda Nal'Shea serves the night elves of Darnassus. She commands an Alliance military outpost in Darkshore.

angles.text: For night elves, Glynda Nal'Shea shows the vigilance needed to protect Kalimdor's sacred shores from aggressive beasts and ancient corruption.
As a hunter, you may recognize Glynda's sharp instincts and direct way of dealing with wild beasts and shoreline predators.
As an Alliance traveler arriving by boat from Teldrassil or the Eastern Kingdoms, you can take Glynda's bounties and help secure Darkshore's perimeter.
